questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black lettering or symbols. They warn you about hazards or special situations ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns of a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians and let them cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools. It tells you to slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves to the right, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings alerts you to an upcoming curve to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped yellow signs indicate a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep slope, and the bottom of low vehicles may drag or catch on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about services. They direct you to rest areas, food, hospitals, and other motorist services.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction you must drive on a one-way street. You must obey this regulation sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead. Be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that a divided highway begins ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you to watch for pedestrians crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Come to a complete stop at the stop line or before entering the intersection. Yield to all other traffic and pedestrians before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a steep hill ahead. Slow down if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road curves right and then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This warning sign indicates the number of lanes is decreasing ahead. Merge left when the right lane ends.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates the road ahead becomes a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: A sharp right turn is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that a lane is ending. Prepare to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped yellow and black warning sign alerts you that wet roads ahead may be slippery. Drive with extra caution and care.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic signals, red is at the top and green is at the bottom. On horizontal signals, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction and maintenance zones. These signs help guide drivers safely through work areas. Traffic fines may double in these zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you that a side road is coming up ahead. Watch for traffic entering from that side road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you the road curves right first, then left. Slow down and stay alert through both curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: A railroad crossing is coming up. Look and listen for trains, slow down, and be ready to stop. Only cross when it is safe and no trains are approaching.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to drive safely over the hill.
